title: Protection paladin: Righteous Fury stays up through the fight

rules.desc: The Protection paladin holds Righteous Fury (aura 20450, 25780 or 25781) for at least 95 percent of its in-combat samples
rules.source: ai/playerbot/strategy/paladin/ProtectionPaladinStrategy.cpp:252-272 (righteous fury rows in and out of combat, ACTION_NORMAL + 1); ai/playerbot/strategy/paladin/PaladinTriggers.h:66 (RighteousFuryTrigger = BUFF_TRIGGER); ai/playerbot/strategy/paladin/PaladinActions.h:73; ai/playerbot/strategy/paladin/PaladinAiObjectContext.cpp:76-78 (buff protection pve/pvp/raid); TortoiseBots upstream/dev abb91ff62
rules.why_expect: the non-combat row puts the buff up before the pull and the combat row re-casts it if it drops (30 min duration, so it should never fall off in a 180 s fight)

rules.desc: At most 30 percent of the mob damage events (hits counted, not amounts) land on the healer or the DPS player; the rest on the tank
rules.source: ai/playerbot/strategy/paladin/ProtectionPaladinStrategy.cpp:51-54 (lose aggro -> hand of reckoning at ACTION_MOVE, judgement at ACTION_MOVE - 1), :58-60 (party member attacked -> hand of reckoning on attacker at ACTION_MOVE, #1156), :19,23 (both fall back to righteous defense); ai/playerbot/strategy/triggers/GenericTriggers.cpp:312-349 (LoseAggroTrigger; the tank-player exception at :328-343); TortoiseBots upstream/dev abb91ff62
rules.why_expect: both paladin taunt rows sit at ACTION_MOVE, far below the warrior's INTERRUPT+1, and their alternative Righteous Defense is not a 1.12 spell; whether Hand of Reckoning is known at level 40 on this core is not proven. Compare with TNK-WAR-MOBS-ON-TANK

rules.desc: Precondition: Battle Stance (aura 2457) stays on the player through the fight
rules.source: precondition, no bot code: setup check player_stance proves the stance at the start, this uptime proves it in the fight
rules.why_expect: the stance is cast in set-up and nothing in the fight removes it; a repeat where it drops shows here instead of passing silently
